ELF parsing, validation, relocation, and loading for sBPF programs.

# Purpose
This file implements the ELF loader for sBPF programs. It parses an ELF binary, checks file and section layout, identifies the `text`, `rodata`, symbol, string, and dynamic relocation sections, and extracts the information needed to build an `fd_sbpf_program_t`. The code supports two parse modes: a strict mode for newer sBPF versions and a lenient mode that matches older Solana ELF rules. It also computes the program entry point, text size, and readonly data size, and it prepares the program object and its call-destination map.

The file also applies ELF relocations in place. It handles `R_BPF_64_64`, `R_BPF_64_RELATIVE`, and `R_BPF_64_32` relocations, resolves local function calls and syscalls, and writes the final values into the program image. After relocation, it registers valid call targets, validates and copies readonly sections, and zeroes gaps between them. The public entry points are [`fd_sbpf_elf_peek`](<#fd_sbpf_elf_peek>), which gathers ELF metadata, [`fd_sbpf_program_new`](<#fd_sbpf_program_new>) and [`fd_sbpf_program_delete`](<#fd_sbpf_program_delete>), which manage program storage, and [`fd_sbpf_program_load`](<#fd_sbpf_program_load>), which completes program loading.
